maya: quick sync: posted a trimmed plan to extract tenant-routing + enrichment into a light-weight routing-decap service. aim: small blast radius, short rollback path. feedback welcome.
drew: looks sensible. primary question: data ownership model during staged cutover? we need clarity on who is authoritative for writes & audits.
sophie: my vote: read-only on new service for at least 72h. keep monolith as canonical writer, add a read-replica and response parity checks. after parity and perf gates, promote incremental write set (telemetry only) before full flip.\m: henry: agree. also add a per-tenant concurrency limiter and a memory soft-cap for routing-decap to avoid hot-tenant OOMs. will prototype token-bucket limiter.
drew: add DB replication sanity: `wal_level` and replication slots + consumer lag alerts. throwing in a schema-compat smoke test for `route_version` changes.
sophie: observability checklist: 1) 100% sampled traces for canary window, 2) per-route histograms, 3) parity diff alerts and a golden-requests set run every 10m. I can wire the OTEL dashboards.\m: draft cutover steps below, trying to keep each step reversible:
- Phase A: infra prep (canary LB rule, certs, VPC peering, KMS access)
- Phase B: deploy routing-decap in shadow mode (mirror traffic for parity only)
- Phase C: enable read-replica reads, run parity job for 24-72h, mismatch threshold 0.2%
- Phase D: 1% opt-in canary (read-only) + perf & error gates (p95 <= baseline, error delta <= 0.5%)
- Phase E: warm cache + staged telemetry writes (idempotent writes only)
- Phase F: progressive ramp to 100% over 48h if gates pass
- Phase G: flip write ownership, rotate certs, retire shadow proxies
- Rollback: instant ff to route back to monolith; maintain monolith writes until explicit flip
drew: add cache invalidation ordering step before final flip: TTL warmup, coordinated flush, and a short drain window. also metric names please.
henry: metrics I'll add: `decap.routing.p95_ms`, `decap.parity_mismatch_count`, `decap.concurrent_per_tenant`, `decap.reject_count`. plus circuit-breaker events.
sophie: add `X-Served-By` header for first two weeks so we can trace incidents. and return `X-Owner` in responses post-flip.\m: owners: infra->drew, telemetry->sophie, caching->henry, rollout automation->maya. please ack with :white_check_mark: when you own.
drew: :white_check_mark:
sophie: :white_check_mark:
henry: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: canary LB rule scheduled: route-rule-331 -> 2025-08-06T03:00Z
maya: timeline: staging rehearse tmrw, 1% canaries Thu-Sat nights, weekend final flip. voice any objections by EOD.
drew: prefer Fri-Sun canaries due to traffic pattern. small ask: rehearse rollback on staging and verify feature-flag fallback default is monolith.
sophie: will prepare golden requests + parity job. will also add alerts for parity alpha > 0.05%.
henry: will prototype limiter and add brief runbook for OOM scenarios.
maya: adding post-cutover retro slot to capture error-budget burn and any contract drift. I'll also author a minimal ownership ledger doc and put it in docs after standup. if anyone spots an unresolved dependency call it out here.
drew: ping infra to confirm cert rotation sequencing with edge LB.
sophie: note: ensure observability retention covers canary period + 2 days for investigation.
maya: thanks all, will follow up with a short RFC link. end of thread.
